info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Banking Facilities Operational Status API
info.description: The Banking Facilities Operational Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of banking facilities. It allows consumers, such as financial institutions and system administrators, to retrieve status information on site operations across multiple locations. This API aids in monitoring functionality, identifying issues, and ensuring optimal service delivery. By leveraging this API, businesses can proactively manage site performance to enhance customer experiences and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the current operational status of facilities.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the real-time operational status of different facilities, helping them to stay informed about ongoing site operations and any potential issues.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain the status of site operations related to facilities. It contains a payload in JSON format that meets the requirements outlined in the schema.

200.description: The current status of site operations was retrieved successfully.
